cardinality.rule: actorMapper.renderMode === ActorRenderMode.VTK_SAMPLED_SLICE: removed from the public API: read the layer of viewport.getRenderPlan() whose displaySetId is the displaySetId of the actor entry and test slice 'cpu' and draw 'gpu'
renderMode === 'vtkVolumeSlice': removed from the public API: read the layer of viewport.getRenderPlan() whose displaySetId is the displaySetId of the actor entry and test slice 'gpuVolume'
renderMode: removed from the render plan layer: read its slice ('frame' | 'cpu' | 'gpuVolume'), draw ('gpu' | 'cpu') and backend
